name: Aryavan Enterprise Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Aryavan Enterprise Ltd is in the business of cloth trading[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company, formerly known as Deepti Alloy Steel Limited, used to manufacture and trade in alloy steel products. In FY19, company changed its name and altered its Main object and added Pharmaceutical business. At present, company provides diversified commercial services viz. IT, Textiles, Manufacturing, FMCG, Pharma, Chemical & Trading. It is also planning to setup a new business for AI and IOT Solutions

pros: Stock is trading at 0.90 times its book value
cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -26.7%
